_comment: Тексты дня второго (E2–E3: M09–M18, Docs/SCENARIO_FINAL.md §7): осмотры, подписи, реакции, тексты крупных планов (механик) и строки предметов. Все draft: true — текст доводит владелец текста (ChatGPT с Директором); голоса для этих строк не записаны (генерация — после текстового прохода Директора). Поле line {speaker, text} — слова персонажа рядом с Агатой или мысль Агаты от первого лица: показывается репликой с именем и звучит голосом персонажа; text — запасной закадровый вариант. Ключи H2d./Z3d./R1d. — дополнения дня 2 в комнаты первого дня. Обязательные реплики сцен — в scenes/E2.json и E3.json.

M3.journal.use.text: The manager's last entry: "Sluice shut for the night. Lever on the nail. Gone home." Last year's date. Below: "Drain one notch at a time and wait, or the banks will give way." The water needed for milling is marked, too.

H2d.stand_zm.mount.text: The office mirror fits into Dunya's stand. The wedges still need tapping in to secure the loose frame.

H2d.office_mirror.clamped._k27: Директор 01.11, «Семнадцатый заход» W232: «всё неверно, переработать» — стекло не темнеет, а проясняется (office_mirror_panel: все клинья забиты — стекло ясное, контора сейчас); «ни звука» снято. Было: «Клинья сели. Потемнев, стекло показывает дверь конторы изнутри: засов в скобах. Ни звука.»

H2d.office_mirror.clamped._k24: Директор 01.11, стр. 36 («комнату со снимка — на деле только дверь»): в стекле — крупный план двери (closeups/M3_view_*), стола нет. Было: «…показывает комнату со снимка: стол, дверь, засов в скобах…»

H2d.office_mirror.bell_mute.text: The bell is mute without its clapper. In Dunya's hand, the label says: "Clapper in the attic chest."

H2d.office_mirror.hook_slipped.text: The hook slipped. Pavel lifts it and starts again.

Bell signals:
One strike — go.

H2d.office_mirror.label_status_loose.text: Frame loose — tap in the wedges.

H2d.office_mirror.label_status_ring_once.text: Ring once — Pavel will bring his lantern to the gap.

H2d.office_mirror.label_status_contact.text: The hook has touched the bolt from below. Ring twice — "stop" — before Pavel pushes!
H2d.office_mirror.label_status_contact._k: Директор 01.11, 22:26 — крюк переделан: Павел ведёт его снизу вверх, крюк упирается в засов снизу: миг для «стой»

H2d.office_mirror.label_bell.text: Bell: click once for "go." Double-click for "stop." Press and hold for a long ring — "raise."

H2d.bell.hang.text: The clapper fits. The bell is as good as new again.

R1d.pelageya.to_boat.text: The ring's on the rope. Time to go. Get in.

R1.exit_R2.closed_check.text: Let Pelageya test it with the empty boat first.

R1.stopper.look_empty.text: Pelageya's rope clamp is empty: she's taken the rope to the bridge pier at the bend.

R1.stopper.look_ring.text: An empty rope clamp. The rope is fastened to the plate's ring at the bend now. There it runs above the water to the far bank. They're holding it there.

R3.exit_R2.closed.text: Go to your mother first. I'll take you back tomorrow.

line.speaker: pelageya
line.text: Go to your mother first. I'll take you back tomorrow.

R3.exit_R2.closed_morning.text: Finish talking to your mother first. She'll show you the path to the school.

H2d.nina_mirror.clamp_early.text: The sluice first — Pavel's waiting by the winch. Once we've drained the water, I'll see to the mirror.

line.speaker: agata
line.text: The sluice first — Pavel's waiting by the winch. Once we've drained the water, I'll see to the mirror.

H1.after_mirror.tikhon_1.text: Did you see Nina? All grey… Then the mistress must have grown old there, too.

line.speaker: tikhon
line.text: Did you see Nina? All grey… Then the mistress must have grown old there, too.

H1.after_mirror.agata.text: I did, Tikhon. While I sleep one night, Mama will live a whole week… How can I sleep now?

direction.emotion: первая фраза медленнее и теплее, с грустью

line.speaker: agata
line.text: I did, Tikhon. While I sleep one night, Mama will live a whole week… How can I sleep now?

H1.after_mirror.tikhon_2.text: How, how… Lie down and sleep, that's how. I sleep every night, and the world's still standing. While you're awake, get on with things. I'll mind the stove.
